title: Raid & Grind dungeons
summary: Seven private dungeons, personal boss checklists and shared rewards, available for live testing.
body:
Live testing: Selected dungeon equipment budgets are raised so comparable Normal rewards exceed Ascended starter gear. Modes, objectives, Keepers and eligibility remain unchanged.

Live testing: Raid and Grind dungeon modes are available from all seven entrance Keepers. Existing legacy runs keep their original behavior until expiry or reset. Gameplay and balance acceptance remain open.

Raid and Grind choices are available in Befallen, Unrest, High Keep, Najena, Cazic-Thule, Permafrost and Nagafen’s Lair. Each run lasts twelve hours and allows up to six characters. Testing and balance acceptance remain open.

Choose a mode

RuleGrindRaid
EnemiesNormal stats and respawns35% more HP, 15% more damage; defeated enemies do not return
BossesRequired bosses available initiallyFinal boss unlocks after all required minibosses
Personal rewardOne Normal itemOne item: 90% Polished, 10% Ascended

Earn your own checklist

The creator chooses the mode. Hail the entrance Keeper for Raid, Grind, Enter, Join, Status, Claim Rewards and Reset. Open Tasks and select your dungeon and mode for its checklist and deadline. Keeper Status lists every required boss, your personal credit and permanent completion counts. A yellow Task Stage Completed message marks one boss objective. A full dungeon clear requires personal credit for every required boss. During live testing, if the task objectives are blank or Completed history is missing, use Keeper Status; these display problems do not erase earned credit or rewards. Stay enrolled, connected and within 200 units of your party’s encounter, including vertical distance. Owned-pet kills count for the owner’s party. Missed kills never receive retroactive credit. Grind respawns offer another opportunity; Raid deaths are permanent for that run.

Shared rewards and exclusive drops

Twenty-four shared designs include eight armor pieces, eight weapon families, six accessories and two weight-reduction bags. Every dungeon uses these designs at its equipment band: Befallen 20; Unrest/Najena 30; High Keep/Cazic-Thule 40; Permafrost/Nagafen’s Lair 50. Selection does not filter by class. Rewards are permanent, tradeable, non-lore and have zero merchant resale. Dungeon rewards cannot be converted by existing forging recipes.

Raid final bosses also drop one, two or three distinct exclusive designs with 80%, 18% and 2% chances. Each independently rolls Polished or Ascended at 90%/10%. Examples include Moltor’s Graveblade, Rucksif’s Mourning Mantle, McCabe’s Hidden Treasury, Vox’s Hoarfrost Satchel and Nagafen’s Emberfang. These shared corpse drops use normal loot controls and are additional to native loot and personal completion rewards.

Weapon delay stays fixed between qualities. Bags have six, eight or ten slots and up to 100% weight reduction. Rewards are selected durably; reconnecting cannot change them. There is one personal completion reward per character per run. A full inventory leaves an earned claim at the Keeper.

Keep progress through interruptions

Progress and the original deadline survive reconnects and restarts. Abandoning the task removes its display, not earned credit. Only the creator can confirm a reset, and no player, pending entry or recoverable player corpse may remain inside. Earned claims survive reset and expiry. Classic Cazic-Thule restoration applies only to managed private instances; High Keep keeps normal faction consequences.

Testing still required

All seven dungeons in both modes need in-game checks. Cazic-Thule paths and doors, inventory/loot recovery and demanding solo/small-group balance remain open. Lady Vox and Lord Nagafen explicitly require level-50 gameplay acceptance. The equipment index covers the separate zone-hunt catalog; dungeon rewards use the designs and bands described here. Existing forging recipes do not upgrade these rewards.
